tools.name: g4f-api (GPT4Free Bridge)
tools.description: Lightweight headless OpenAI-compatible API server powered by gpt4free, optimized for Termux with zero heavy GUI.

commands.install: if [ -d ~/Crouter-Plugin/.git ]; then cd ~/Crouter-Plugin && git fetch origin main && git checkout origin/main -- g4f-api; else rm -rf ~/Crouter-Plugin && git clone https://github.com/myfunuiai-del/Crouter-Plugin.git ~/Crouter-Plugin; fi && cd ~/Crouter-Plugin/g4f-api && bash install.sh
commands.update: cd ~/Crouter-Plugin && git fetch origin main && git pull origin main
